app.name: MakeMyTrip Flight, Hotel, Bus
app.description: India's leading travel booking app for flights, hotels, buses, cabs, trains, and holiday packages.

verdict.one_liner: India's biggest travel app that collects everything from your passport to your phone contacts, then shares it with airlines, hotels, advertisers, and business partners.
verdict.summary: MakeMyTrip is India's largest online travel company. The app collects extensive personal information including identity documents (passport, Aadhar, PAN, driving license), credit/debit card details, banking information, COVID-19 vaccination status, and even your phone contacts. This data is shared with airlines, hotels, bus operators, cab services, railways, group companies, business partners (including banks and insurance companies), and advertising networks. The app requests an extraordinary number of device permissions including access to contacts, SMS, calendar, Bluetooth, IMEI/IMSI, SIM serial number, and phone calls.
verdict.recommendation_reason: While MakeMyTrip is a dominant travel platform in India, users should understand the vast scope of personal and sensitive data collected—including government IDs, financial details, vaccination status, and phone contacts—and the extensive sharing of this data with third-party service providers, advertisers, and business partners.

red.title: Collects passport, Aadhar, and driving license
red.plain_english: The app asks for copies of your passport, Aadhar card, driving license, election card, and PAN card for bookings, visa services, and hotel check-ins.

red.title: Your phone contacts are synced to their servers
red.plain_english: If you allow contacts access, the app copies your phone contacts to its servers to help you share trips with friends and make referrals.

red.title: The app reads your SMS messages
red.plain_english: If you give permission, the app reads your text messages to automatically fill in OTPs during payments and to verify your phone number.

red.title: Your credit and debit card details are stored
red.plain_english: The app stores your credit and debit card information—including cardholder name, card number, expiration date, and banking details—to make future bookings faster.

red.title: Collects your phone's unique identifiers
red.plain_english: The app collects your device's IMEI, IMSI, SIM serial number, and Android ID to identify you and prevent fraud.

green.title: Payments are encrypted
green.plain_english: The app uses TLS encryption to protect your payment information when you send it.

green.title: You can delete your account
green.plain_english: You have the option to delete your account through a provided link.

green.title: Only for adults 18 and older
green.plain_english: You must be at least 18 years old to use the app and provide consent for data processing.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The app uses your camera to upload profile pictures, scan QR codes for UPI payments, and take photos or videos for hotel reviews. The microphone is used for audio in video reviews.
categories.detail: Camera access is used for: uploading profile pictures, sharing hotel review images, scanning QR codes for UPI payments, and recording video reviews. Audio permission ensures video reviews have clear audio. This is optional but integrated into core review and payment features.
categories.policy_excerpt: This permission enables you to use your camera from within the application to upload a new profile picture, upload an image for sharing hotel reviews and also allows you to take videos to upload as video reviews on our application.
concerns: Photos and videos uploaded for reviews stored on servers
QR code scanning for payments requires camera access
Video reviews may contain personal or location information

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The app tracks your location to auto-fill your nearest airport or city, recommend nearby hotels for last-minute bookings, and show location-specific deals.
categories.detail: Location permission enables auto-detection of nearest airport/city, hotel recommendations based on proximity, personalized deals, and time zone determination for international travel. Location data is also shared with third-party advertisers for targeted ads. Wi-Fi connection information is used to optimize map details and image loading.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you launch MakeMyTrip app to make a travel booking, we auto-detect your location so that your nearest airport or city is auto-filled. We also require this permission to recommend you nearest hotels in case you are running late.
concerns: Precise location collected and stored
Location used for targeted advertising
Wi-Fi connection information tracked

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you allow contacts access, the app copies your phone contacts to its servers so you can share trips with friends, send referrals, and get hotel recommendations based on where your friends stayed.
categories.detail: Contacts access enables: sharing hotel/flight/holiday bookings with friends, inviting friends to try the app, sending referral links, and making hotel recommendations based on friends' stays. The privacy policy explicitly states that contacts information will be stored on MMT servers and synced from your phone.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you allow us to access your contacts, it enables us to provide a lot of social features to you... This information will be stored on our servers and synced from your phone.
concerns: Full phone contacts uploaded to MMT servers
Contact data used for recommendations and referrals
Friends' travel preferences inferred from contact data

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You can upload government ID documents like passport, Aadhar, and driving license for hotel check-ins, visa applications, and identity verification. The app also saves map data to your phone's storage.
categories.detail: Users upload government identification documents (Aadhar, driving license, election card) for contactless hotel check-in, passport copies and bank statements for visa services, COVID-19 vaccination certificates, and PAN information for international bookings. The app also accesses external storage to save map data locally for a seamless hotel selection experience.
categories.policy_excerpt: In case you opt for contactless check-in at Hotels, then copies of your government identification like aadhar, driving license, election card etc... If you request MMT to provide visa related services, then copies of your passport, bank statements, originals of the filled in application forms, photographs, and any other information which may be required by the respective embassy.
concerns: Government ID documents uploaded and stored
Passport and bank statements collected for visa services
COVID-19 vaccination certificates collected
PAN card details required for international bookings

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your personal information is shared with airlines, hotels, bus operators, cab services, railways, group companies, business partners (banks and insurance companies), advertisers, and third-party service providers.
categories.detail: MMT shares personal information with: end service providers (airlines, hotels, bus providers, cab rental, railways) for booking fulfillment; group companies and affiliates for personalization and service efficiency; business partners (co-branded credit cards, travel insurance, banking cards) for offers; third-party vendors for payment processing, data hosting, and data processing; advertising companies and advertisers for targeted ads; and law enforcement when required. MMT explicitly states that how service providers use the shared information is beyond their control.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your information shall be shared with the end service providers like airlines, hotels, bus service providers, cab rental, railways or any other suppliers who are responsible for fulfilling your booking... MMT does not authorize the end service provider to use your information for any other purpose(s) except as may be for fulfilling their part of service. However, how the said service providers/suppliers use the information shared with them is beyond the purview and control of MMT.
concerns: Data shared with airlines, hotels, and transport providers
Shared with group companies and affiliates
Business partners include banks and insurance companies
Third-party advertisers receive behavioral data
Service provider usage beyond MMT's control
Data may be transferred in case of merger or acquisition

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You must provide extensive personal details including name, gender, religion, age, marital status, email, phone number, postal address, and profile picture to create an account and make bookings.
categories.detail: Account creation requires: personal identity information (name, gender, marital status, religion, age, profile picture), contact details (email, postal addresses, phone numbers, fax numbers), banking details (credit/debit card information, billing info, payment history), and travel-related details (frequent flyer numbers). Users may also provide lifestyle and income information. Government IDs may be required for verification and bookings.
categories.policy_excerpt: Information which you provide while subscribing to or registering on the Website, including but not limited to information about your personal identity such as name, gender, marital status, religion, age, profile picture etc., your contact details such as your email address, postal addresses, frequent flyer number, telephone (mobile or otherwise) and/or fax numbers.
concerns: Extensive identity and personal data required
Religion and marital status collected
Income and lifestyle information requested
Government documents required for certain bookings

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The app tracks your browsing activity, click patterns, and travel preferences using cookies and pixel tags to show you targeted ads and travel deals.
categories.detail: MMT uses cookies to personalize experience and display advertisements. Third-party advertising cookies track ad effectiveness and use aggregated statistics about website visits to provide targeted advertisements. Pixel tags are used to measure advertising effectiveness. The app also collects session data including IP address, operating system, browser type, activities conducted, frequency of visits, and duration of sessions. This data is used to analyze choices, diagnose server problems, and personalize content.
categories.policy_excerpt: MMT uses cookies to personalize your experience on the Website and the advertisements that maybe displayed... A cookie may also be placed by our advertising servers, or third party advertising companies. Such cookies are used for purposes of tracking the effectiveness of advertising served by us on any website, and also to use aggregated statistics about your visits to the Website in order to provide advertisements in the Website or any other website about services that may be of potential interest to you.
concerns: Third-party advertising cookies used
Pixel tags track ad effectiveness
Clickstream and browsing behavior logged
Session data used for personalization and advertising
Aggregated data shared with advertisers and affiliates

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app is only for adults 18 and older. You must be at least 18 to use the app and consent to data processing.
categories.detail: MMT requires users to be at least 18 years of age to transact directly and consent to processing of personal data. The platform is not directed at children and does not have specific child-directed features.
categories.policy_excerpt: You must atleast 18 years of age to transact directly with MMT and also to consent to the processing of your personal data.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app logs your IP address, browser type, operating system, and what you do on the website every time you visit.
categories.detail: MMT collects session data including IP address, operating system, browser software, activities conducted on the website, frequency of visits, and duration of sessions. This is used to analyze user choices, diagnose server problems, and better administer systems. The policy claims this information cannot identify users personally, but it may be possible to determine a user's Internet Service Provider and approximate geographic location.
categories.policy_excerpt: Session data may consist of various aspects like the IP address, operating system and type of browser software being used and the activities conducted by the User while on the Website.
concerns: IP address logged on every visit
Clickstream and activities tracked
ISP and approximate location inferable from session data

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects extensive information about your device including its unique ID, IMEI, IMSI, SIM serial number, hardware model, OS version, Bluetooth status, and Wi-Fi connection details.
categories.detail: MMT collects comprehensive device data including: OS name and version, mobile network, hardware model, unique device identifier, preferred language, IMEI/IMSI, SIM serial number, Android ID, device ID, Bluetooth status, Wi-Fi connection, and subscription information. This is used for: optimizing travel booking experience, fraud prevention, UPI services, auto-filling fields, and identifying users uniquely. The policy states these permissions cannot be customized and are required for the app to function.
categories.policy_excerpt: We need your device permission to get information about your device, like OS (operating system) name, OS version, mobile network, hardware model, unique device identifier, preferred language, etc.
concerns: IMEI/IMSI collected for fraud prevention
SIM serial number read for UPI authentication
Unique device identifiers collected
Bluetooth and Wi-Fi status tracked
Permissions cannot be customized

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The app may collect your COVID-19 vaccination status and certificate if you want to use services that require it or access it later for travel.
categories.detail: Users may provide COVID-19 vaccination status and certificate if required for certain services or for later travel access. MMT states they will never process the beneficiary ID and other ID details contained in the vaccination certificate, and will redact sensitive information. However, the vaccination status itself is collected and may be shared with service providers.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your Covid-19 Vaccination status and certificate in case you wish to avail any service for provision of which such Covid-19 vaccination related information is required or want to access your vaccination certificate at a later stage for travel related or any other purpose.
concerns: COVID-19 vaccination status collected
Vaccination certificate may be shared with service providers
Health-related travel requirement data stored

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The app stores your credit and debit card details—including cardholder name, card number, and expiration date—to make future bookings faster. It also collects PAN information for international bookings.
categories.detail: MMT collects and stores payment details including: cardholder name, credit/debit card number (in encrypted form), expiration date, banking details, wallet details, billing information, and payment history. PAN information may be required for international bookings under RBI's Liberalized Remittance Scheme. MMT states they will never share PAN details without prior consent unless required by law enforcement. Credit/debit card data is encrypted using TLS.
categories.policy_excerpt: While making a booking, we may use Personal Information including, payment details which include cardholder name, credit/debit card number (in encrypted form) with expiration date, banking details, wallet details etc. as shared and allowed to be stored by you.
concerns: Credit/debit card numbers stored (even if encrypted)
Banking and wallet details collected
PAN information required for international bookings
Payment history retained

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your account and correct your personal information. However, the app does not specify exactly how long they keep your data after deletion.
categories.detail: Users can access, correct, or delete personal information from their user account. MMT states that personal information is retained as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes listed in the policy, and in some circumstances may be retained longer for legal, regulatory, tax, or accounting requirements. When no longer required, data is either securely deleted or stored in a way that it will no longer be used. Account deletion is available via a link.
categories.policy_excerpt: MMT will retain your Personal Information on its servers for as long as is reasonably necessary for the purposes listed in this policy. In some circumstances we may retain your Personal Information for longer periods of time, for instance where we are required to do so in accordance with any legal, regulatory, tax or accounting requirements.
concerns: Vague retention timelines
Data may be retained for extended periods for legal requirements
No specific deletion timeframe mentioned

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: MakeMyTrip says they will notify you when they make changes to the privacy policy.
categories.detail: MMT reserves the right to revise the Privacy Policy from time to time to suit legal, business, and customer requirements. They state they will duly notify users as may be necessary when changes are made.
categories.policy_excerpt: We reserve the rights to revise the Privacy Policy from time to time to suit various legal, business and customer requirement. We will duly notify the users as may be necessary.
